caption: The input bit d reaches one RSC encoder directly and the second through the interleaver. The multiplexer sends d with p1 and p2: three bits per input bit, rate 1/3. The dashed path marks the systematic bit going straight to the output.

spec.title: Turbo encoder, rate 1/3
spec.aria: Turbo encoder: the input block feeds one RSC encoder directly and a second one through an interleaver, and the multiplexer sends out the systematic bit with both parity streams.
